claims.claim: Vancouver voters set a new single-day early-voting record on Wednesday with more than 25,000 advance ballots cast in the municipal election.
claims.source_title: Vancouver smashes single-day early voting turnout record with over 25K ballots cast
claims.supporting_quote: Vancouver voters looking to turn in an advance ballot in the municipal election set a new record on Wednesday.

claims.claim: Average asking rent in B.C. fell 2.9 percent in September, and Rentals.ca and Urbanation said the figures mark two full years of annual declines, the longest recent Canadian rental downturn.
claims.episode_span: Average asking rent in British Columbia fell 2.9 percent in September
claims.source_title: Average asking rent down 2.9% in B.C. in September, marking 2 years of decreases: report
claims.supporting_quote: A monthly report from Rentals.ca and Urbanation said the figures mark two full years of annual declines, the longest downturn the Canadian rental market has experienced in recent history.

claims.claim: Three horses were killed and a fourth injured in a B.C. highway crash while travelling to the Equestrian Canada National Dressage West championship in Langley.
claims.episode_span: Three horses were killed and a fourth was injured
claims.source_title: 'Unimaginable loss': Horses killed on B.C. highway while travelling to championship
claims.supporting_quote: Four horses were travelling from across Western Canada to compete in the Equestrian Canada National Dressage West championship in Langley. Three were killed in a crash, and another was injured.

claims.claim: Crown prosecutors are seeking a two-year jail term for Kyle Nicholas Luca, 31, who pleaded guilty in September to impaired driving causing bodily harm and failing to stop at an accident involving bodily harm in a baby-stroller hit-and-run.
claims.episode_span: Crown prosecutors are seeking a two-year jail term for Kyle Nicholas Luca, 31
claims.source_title: Crown seeks 2-year jail term for B.C. driver in baby stroller hit-and-run
claims.supporting_quote: Kyle Nicholas Luca, 31, pleaded guilty in September to impaired driving causing bodily harm and failing to stop at an accident involving bodily harm.

claims.claim: Dr. Bonnie Henry said Wednesday that free vaccines will be available against influenza, COVID-19 and others as flu cases circulate.
claims.episode_span: Free vaccines against influenza, COVID-19 and other illnesses will be available
claims.source_title: B.C. rolling out fall vaccine program as flu cases circulating
claims.supporting_quote: In an update on Wednesday, B.C.'s provincial health officer, Dr. Bonnie Henry, said free vaccines will be available against influenza, COVID-19 and others.

claims.claim: Interim B.C. Conservative leader Lorne Doerkson is campaigning a second day in Surrey to make a policy announcement, after the party promised to eliminate the PST on some equipment.
claims.episode_span: interim leader Lorne Doerkson is there to make a policy announcement
claims.source_title: B.C. Conservatives back in battleground Surrey on election trail
claims.supporting_quote: The Conservatives say interim leader Lorne Doerkson will be in Surrey to make a policy announcement a day after being in the city to roll out promises for businesses that include eliminating the PST on some equipment.

claims.claim: Surrey holds 10 of 93 ridings in the Oct. 24 election, and in 2024 Garry Begg won Surrey-Guildford by 22 votes, securing a one-seat NDP majority.
claims.episode_span: holds 10 of the 93 ridings on the Oct. 24 ballot
claims.source_title: B.C. Conservatives back in battleground Surrey on election trail
claims.supporting_quote: Surrey is British Columbia’s second-largest municipality and includes 10 of the 93 electoral ridings that are up for grabs when voters go to the polls on Oct. 24.

claims.claim: The North Shore Wastewater Treatment Plant budget rose from 700 million dollars to 3.9 billion and the timeline extended by a decade; Buchanan and Little want a provincial inquiry, while Metro Vancouver says another review would be an unnecessary cost and expects independent findings by January 2027.
claims.episode_span: construction budget has risen from 700 million dollars to 3.9 billion
claims.source_title: Metro Vancouver Regional District defends its roles and services targeted by B.C. Conservatives
claims.supporting_quote: On the North Shore Wastewater Project, which has seen its construction budget escalate from $700 million to $3.9 billion and its construction timeline extended by a decade, the regional government has commissioned an independent review, and is already examining its escalating costs and oversight, with findings expected by January 2027.

claims.claim: Mike Hurley said claims that Metro Vancouver is out of control use outdated or untrue information; the district says less than eight percent of its operating budget goes to non-utility services, and the Iona Island estimate fell from 9.9 billion dollars to 6 billion.
claims.episode_span: less than eight percent of its operating budget goes to non-utility services
claims.source_title: Metro Vancouver Regional District defends its roles and services targeted by B.C. Conservatives
claims.supporting_quote: To continue to claim that Metro Vancouver is out of control is simply using the organization as a political punching bag to get attention,” said Mike Hurley
